canonical_id: External-memory representation and retrieval granularity for cross-task experience reuse in LLM agents

source.paper: When Continual Learning Moves to Memory: A Study of Experience Reuse in LLM Agents

paper_protocol.framework: frozen-backbone non-parametric continual learning over an external memory M, with two sequential task phases A and B and no weight updates
paper_protocol.base_system: ReAct-style interaction built on AgentGym with the ReMe memory module; BM25 retrieval throughout
paper_protocol.data_budget: 200 training instances per task phase and 100 test instances per task; results averaged over two independent runs

study_1.raw: complete action-observation trajectory per episode, top-1 memory retrieval
study_1.insight: LLM-distilled abstract strategy insights, approximately three per instance, aggregated into one task-level memory keyed by original task instruction, top-1 retrieval

study_2.cond_agg: one task-level insight bundle per instance, top-1 retrieval once at episode start
study_2.cond_ind: each insight stored separately with an LLM-generated when_to_use key, top-3 once at episode start
study_2.cond_step: same insight-level storage as Cond-Ind but re-query every four execution steps; approximately three insights surfaced per retrieval event

paper_protocol.reported_directional_evidence: clean worker primary extraction reports ALFWorld A→B FWT raw -9.5pp versus insight +6.5pp; BabyAI raw -7.5pp versus insight +9.0pp; ALFWorld hard baseline-fail subset raw ΔNL -26.1pp versus insight +3.3pp. BabyAI organization effects are direction-dependent: Cond-Ind A→B +15.0pp FWT versus Cond-Agg +9.0pp, but B→A Cond-Ind -1.0pp versus Cond-Agg +7.5pp; Cond-Step can help or hurt depending on target execution structure.
paper_protocol.claim_scope: two environment/task-family pairs, frozen Qwen-Plus backbone, AgentGym/ReMe/BM25, finite top-k retrieval, 200-instance sequential phases and two-run averages. The results support a design warning about representation/retrieval interference under this protocol, not a universal theorem that abstract memory always dominates raw trajectories or that any particular memory granularity is optimal.

artifact_evidence.paper_specific_repository: No author-associated repository or paper-specific code/data release for arXiv:2604.27003 was identified by targeted web and GitHub repository searches on 2026-08-25.

base_components.AgentGym: AgentGym is public and provides ALFWorld/BabyAI-capable agent-environment infrastructure, datasets/benchmark tooling and evaluation controllers, but the paper does not pin an AgentGym commit/release in the text surfaced during this audit.
base_components.ReMe: agentscope-ai/ReMe is a substantial public memory-management project. Its current main at audit time was 626c850ccb2c25be92a9ce575886a85f54e8683a (2026-08-24), but this is not evidence that this commit matches the paper's April 2026 experiment. The paper citation to ReMe does not by itself bind an exact package/repository revision for the reported runs.
base_components.BM25: the retrieval algorithm is standard and specified, but the tokenizer/preprocessing/scoring implementation and exact index construction used for paper memories are not bound to a released experiment artifact.

artifact_evidence.protocol_transparency: The preprint appendix is unusually explicit about run labels, FWT/BWT/RR/NL metrics, AgentGym+ReMe+BM25, storage/retrieval conditions, top-k, four-step Cond-Step frequency, Qwen-Plus backbone, 200/100 train/test counts and two-run averaging. This makes conceptual reimplementation feasible even without a release.
missing_paper_artifacts: No paper-specific source tree or immutable experiment commit was identified.
No exact Qwen-Plus provider/model snapshot or API-version/date binding was identified in the surfaced protocol; a hosted model can change underneath the experiment.
No released exact ALFWorld/BabyAI task-instance lists/splits for the two task families were identified.
No exact prompts for ReAct action generation, raw-memory insertion, insight distillation, when_to_use generation, or memory formatting were identified as versioned files in a paper artifact.
No exact AgentGym/ReMe revisions, BM25 library/settings/tokenization or context-budget/truncation settings were bound to an experiment manifest.
No committed per-instance trajectories, generated insight memories, retrieval results, run seeds/provider randomness controls, or raw two-run score ledgers were identified.
No one-command or containerized reproduction environment for the paper-specific modifications was identified.

reproducibility_assessment.official_artifact_support: moderate at the protocol/base-component level, weak at the exact paper-run level. AgentGym and ReMe are public, and the appendix is detailed, but the experiment glue, exact revisions/prompts/splits/provider identity and raw outputs are not publicly pinned in a paper-specific artifact identified in this audit.
reproducibility_assessment.independent_replication: No clear independent provenance-equivalent numerical reproduction of the ALFWorld/BabyAI transfer results was identified in the targeted public search on 2026-08-25. Secondary summaries and visualizations repeat the paper results but are not independent reruns. Absence of located evidence is not evidence that none exists.
reproducibility_assessment.failed_independent_replication: None identified in the targeted search; do not interpret the missing release or missing rerun as a failed scientific replication.
reproducibility_assessment.judgment: This is a high-information experimental design with enough appendix detail to reconstruct the conceptual ablations, and its underlying AgentGym/ReMe ecosystem is public. However, exact numerical reproducibility is currently limited by missing paper-specific artifacts and hosted-model/version dependence. The strongest downstream-safe statement is that the study provides primary preprint evidence that memory representation and retrieval granularity can cause directional transfer/forgetting effects under the specified Qwen-Plus + AgentGym/ReMe/BM25 protocol. It does not yet provide a provenance-equivalent public artifact trail sufficient to independently recompute the reported pp deltas.
exact_blockers: No paper-specific repository/commit or archived experiment package was identified.
Qwen-Plus is a hosted backbone and the exact immutable model/API snapshot used for the reported runs is not pinned by a public artifact identified here.
Exact AgentGym and ReMe revisions are not bound to the paper runs; current public ReMe is newer than the paper submission and cannot be assumed equivalent.

Task-instance splits, prompts, memory serialization, BM25 preprocessing/index settings, context-budget policy, seeds and raw outputs are not available in a single immutable manifest identified in this audit.
Only two independent runs are reported, making variance/stability especially important; raw per-run ledgers are not publicly pinned in an identified artifact.
No independent provenance-equivalent rerun was located in the targeted search window.
reproducibility_assessment.scope: Supports a scoped design-warning candidate for external-memory agents. Artifact gaps reduce replayability but do not constitute evidence against abstract-insight memory, raw trajectories, ReMe, AgentGym, or the broader experience-reuse family.

recommended_matched_reproduction.minimum_viable: Freeze a public AgentGym commit, ReMe commit, open-weight or immutable-version backbone, BM25 implementation, exact task-instance lists and all prompts. Reproduce only Study 1 A→B on one environment first, with raw versus insight under identical top-1/context budgets and at least 3-5 seeds/runs.
recommended_matched_reproduction.diagnostic: Persist each source episode, memory object, retrieval ranking, injected context and action trace so FWT plus RR/NL can be recomputed and negative transfer localized to retrieval versus generation.
recommended_matched_reproduction.extension: Only after Study 1 ordering is reproduced should Cond-Agg/Cond-Ind/Cond-Step be tested. Keep storage granularity, number of surfaced insights and retrieval-event count separately budgeted; otherwise retrieval frequency and context volume are confounded.
